text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I'm going to make some refreshments before training starts. ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hmmm… I wonder what Trainer would like.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hmm, vegetables are cheap… But if I want to cover all the nutritional bases, then I'll need some meat too!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Actually, while I'm at it, I should try cooking up a new dish.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'm pretty sure there were a ton of cookbooks at the bookstore in the mall.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I know! I should make something that'll keep for a while. I'll grab a cookbook with tasty recipes that can be frozen, and—

text_block_list.name: PA Announcement
text_block_list.text: Attention all shoppers! A limited-time sale on meats will be starting soon! Act now before they're sold out!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Goodness! I need to get some before they sell out!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Nnngh… I'm sure it'll be fine if I'm only a tiny bit late.
